Verses.VerseEn: By the soft blowing pleasant breezes which blow in succession,
Then by the violent winds which blow with fierce gusts,
And by those which spread the clouds all around,
Then by those which split (them) apart and break them off,
Then by those which bring direction and guidance,
To accomplish the argument or to warn,
Surely the promise (of the Last Day) which is being given to you will be certainly fulfilled.
Then when the light of the stars will be extinguished,
And when the heavenly universe will be split open,
And when the mountains will be (broken down to dust) and blown off,
And when the Messengers will be brought together at the appointed time (to bear witness to their respective communities),

Words.MeaningEn: are gathered to their appointed time

Verses.VerseEn: Well, for what Day is the term (of all the affairs) appointed?
For the Day of Judgment!
And who has told you what the Day of Judgment is?
Woe (and devastation) to the deniers on that Day!
Did We not destroy the people (who denied) before?
Then We cause the later ones also to follow them (in destruction).
This is how We sort out (the matter) with the evildoers.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
Did We not create you from (a drop) of detestable fluid?
Then We placed it in a secure place (i.e. the mother’s womb),
Till an appointed period (of time).
Then We determined time periods (for all the stages of growth from conception to birth). And how excellent do We determine!
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
Have We not made the earth an assembling expanse,
(That draws together) the living (as well as) the dead?

Verses.VerseAr: وَّجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا رَاوسِىَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَّاَسۡقَيۡنٰكُمۡ مَّآءً فُرَاتًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: We placed on it soaring high and firm mountains and gave you sweet water to drink (from springs of sweet fresh water).

Words.MeaningEn: and We gave you to drink

Verses.VerseEn: Woe to the deniers on that Day!

Verses.VerseAr: اِنْطَلِقُوۡۤا اِلٰى مَا كُنۡتُمۡ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوۡنَ‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Now) move on to that (torment) which you used to deny.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنْطَلِقُوۡۤا اِلٰى ظِلٍّ ذِىۡ ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Proceed towards that shadow (of the smoke of Hell) that forks into three columns,

Verses.VerseAr: لَّا ظَلِيۡلٍ وَّلَا يُغۡنِىۡ مِنَ اللَّهَبِؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: A shadow which is neither cool nor protecting against the heat of fire.
Indeed that (Hell) throws up sparks and flames (huge) as a lofty palace.
(It also appears) as if those (sparks) are yellow camels.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
This is a Day (on which) they will not be able to speak too.
Nor will they be allowed to offer any excuses.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
This is the Day of Judgment (on which) We will gather you and (all) the earlier communities.
Then if you have any scheme (and trick to escape from the torment), try (that) against Me.
Woe (dejection) to the deniers on that Day!
Surely the Godfearing will be (rejoicing) under cool shades and amid springs.
And whatever fruits they will long for (will be available for them).

Verses.VerseAr: كُلُوۡا وَاشۡرَبُوۡا هَنِيْٓئًاۢ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: (It will be said to them:) ‘Enjoy eating and drinking to your taste as a reward for what you used to do.’
Indeed the same way do we We reward the pious.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
(O deniers of Truth!) Eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while. No doubt, you are the evildoers.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ ارۡكَعُوۡا لَا يَرۡكَعُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when it is said to them: ‘Bow down (before Allah),’ they do not bow.
Woe to the deniers on that Day!
Then in what Revelations after this (Qur’an) will they believe?
